purpose: Group a related heading, content and optional actions.
avoid: Do not create nested ambiguous clickable surfaces.
basis: Native source page 72:2721 (Card), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: A text heading, description and body identify the group; imagery or card color is not its sole meaning.
updatesAndDescendants: Card and its slots are native div wrappers. CardTitle does not automatically become a heading, and the whole card is not inherently clickable. Parent content updates rerender normally; descendants own their actions.
referenceDecision: The h2 is deliberately supplied as CardTitle children in this reference. Consumers choose heading level from document hierarchy.
